I’m sorry, but the Coastline Slide (item O‑1011‑1) was sold as a final‑sale item, so it can’t be returned or exchanged [[returns-policy#final-sale-items]].  
It is still covered by our 1‑year warranty against defects, so if you notice any issues you can file a warranty claim.  
If you’d like to proceed with a warranty claim or need help with anything else, just let me know or contact support@stride.example.
